title: FinCore - Personal Finance & Islamic Wealth Management System
shortDescription: A full-stack finance management application that helps users track income, expenses, and assets with upcoming Islamic financial principles integration (Khums & Zakat).
features: JWT-based authentication with automatic token refresh and email verification
Categorized income and expense tracking with hierarchical category system
Real-time financial dashboard with visual breakdowns and progress indicators
Comprehensive financial reporting with category-wise analytics
RESTful API architecture with secure, user-specific data isolation
Responsive UI with modern glassmorphic design and smooth animations
